hypothesis: A prior external-liquidity raid has positive reversal expectancy only when exchange-reported forced liquidation is followed by opposite aggressive flow, depleted-side BBO refill, range reclaim and a completed micro-structure shift before entry.

smc_ict_mapping.liquidity_sweep: first trade-through of that level by at least 2 or 5 bp
smc_ict_mapping.forced_delivery: same-direction exchange-reported liquidation notional above a fit-only 90th or 97th percentile
smc_ict_mapping.absorption: opposite signed trade notional fraction and destination-side BBO refill
smc_ict_mapping.reclaim: completed midprice returns inside the raided level
smc_ict_mapping.mss_cisd: completed price breaks the opposite prior 3- or 10-second micro swing
smc_ict_mapping.invalidation: actual observed sweep extreme plus max(one spread, 1 bp)
smc_ict_mapping.objective: prior range equilibrium or 2R structural target

execution_contract.entry: first executable BBO quote after completed MSS plus configured latency
execution_contract.exit: first executable opposite BBO quote after structural stop or target trigger plus configured latency

staging.development: only up to the twelve highest-growth complete fit survivors, frozen without parameter changes

top_trade_removal: Identify the largest 10% of positive 12-bp event keys, exclude them before global-slot competition and rerun from initial NAV.
promotion_boundary: This sparse fatal screen is never ranking eligible. A survivor must be expanded under the exact frozen rule across every remaining pre-2024 first-day sample with exact funding and deeper execution before 2024 can open.
